rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion to a narrow, institutionally cautious holding grounded in § 524(e), the “not inconsistent” limit in § 1123(b)(6), and the structural inference from § 524(g)’s express carveout, while invoking Law v. Siegel and Jevic to reject § 105(a) as a source of new substantive power. Several Justices may write short concurrences to emphasize textualism/separation-of-powers (Thomas/Gorsuch/Barrett), practical-abuse concerns (Alito), or fairness/process to victims (Sotomayor/Jackson) without fracturing the 9-0 judgment.
